enemy.name: 'Personal Security Consultant'
enemy.flavour_text:
An employee of the Warehouse 22 security firm. He's considered resigning, but fears ending up next on his colleagues' hit list.
Prefers being a private soldier for a perfumed noble to being an unidentified corpse found in a pipe. At the very least, he wasn't assigned to that smelly fool Gromov.

abilities.text: Sticks close to <Pavlovich, Magistrate> when he is making a speech, and retreats when Pavlovich is dead
When any unit is discovered by Sentry Turrets, increases Movement Speed and dashes towards the discovered unit within a large search range
Nearby enemies take reduced Physical and Arts damage
